issues.t: Brake fluid reservoir cap can let air in
issues.sym: The brake pedal travels farther than normal and the SUV needs more distance to stop.
issues.why: The filler cap on the brake fluid reservoir can draw air into the system. Toyota recalled affected 2001 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN. If the pedal feels low or soft, have the brakes inspected before driving further.

issues.t: Fuel vapor nozzle can break in a frontal crash
issues.sym: No warning signs in normal driving. The risk is a fuel leak after a front-end collision.
issues.why: A clamp near the fuel vapor nozzle can break the nozzle in a frontal impact. Toyota recalled 2001-2002 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and have the free repair done. Any fuel smell needs attention right away.

issues.t: Rear child safety lock can release on its own
issues.sym: A rear door that was child-locked can be opened from inside.
issues.why: The rear child protection lock may be released unintentionally. Toyota recalled 2001-2004 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and test the child locks before carrying young kids in the back.

issues.t: Climate control temperature acts erratically
issues.sym: The temperature dial stops having any effect, air stays stuck on hot or cold, or the temperature changes on its own while the fan still works.
issues.why: Solder joints on the circuit board behind the temperature control can crack and lose contact. Some owners also find broken wiring.
issues.next: A shop can re-solder the board or replace the control unit. It is a comfort issue, but get defrost working before winter.

issues.t: Evaporative emissions leak code
issues.sym: Check-engine light with an EVAP code such as P0446. The SUV usually drives normally.
issues.why: Parts of the fuel vapor system fail with age. The charcoal canister is a common culprit, and sometimes only the vacuum switching valve is bad.
issues.next: Have the EVAP system smoke-tested and check the simpler valve before replacing the canister.

issues.t: Crankshaft pulley can separate and drop the power steering belt
issues.sym: Steering suddenly gets very heavy, sometimes with a squeal or slapping noise from the engine.
issues.why: Adhesive in the crankshaft pulley may be inadequate, letting the power steering belt come off. Toyota recalled 2004-2005 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN. If steering goes heavy, pull over safely and have it towed.

issues.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak
issues.sym: Brake fluid level drops, the brake warning light comes on, or the pedal sinks or feels soft.
issues.why: Non-polymer brake fluid used in service can dry out a master cylinder seal and cause a leak. Toyota recalled 2004-2006 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN. Do not keep driving with a brake warning light or a sinking pedal.

issues.t: Console carpet cover can interfere with the gas pedal
issues.sym: The accelerator pedal feels obstructed or does not return fully.
issues.why: Loose carpet clips near the console can let the cover move against the accelerator pedal. Toyota recalled these years twice.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and make sure nothing is near the pedal. If the pedal sticks, shift to neutral and stop safely.

issues.t: VVT-i oil hose can leak
issues.sym: Sudden oil leak at the engine, abnormal engine noise, or the oil pressure light coming on.
issues.why: The rubber section of the variable valve timing oil hose can break down and leak. Toyota covers a metal replacement hose under a service campaign.
issues.next: Ask a Toyota dealer to check the VIN for the campaign. If the oil pressure light comes on, shut the engine off right away.

issues.t: Engine oil cooler pipe leaks
issues.sym: Oil drips under the front of the engine or a burning oil smell under the hood.
issues.why: The original oil cooler pipe can seep or leak. Toyota released an updated all-metal part and extended coverage on it.
issues.next: Have the pipe checked at oil changes and ask the dealer about warranty enhancement ZE2. Stop if the oil pressure light comes on.

issues.t: Ignition coil misfires
issues.sym: Check-engine light with misfire or coil codes, rough idle, or shaking under acceleration.
issues.why: The original ignition coils can fail. Toyota issued a bulletin with an updated coil.
issues.next: Have the codes read and replace the failing coil with the updated part. If the check engine light flashes, pull over when it's safe and turn the engine off.

issues.t: Starts in Neutral but not in Park
issues.sym: The engine will not crank in Park but starts with the shifter in Neutral.
issues.why: The neutral start switch can fail. Toyota issued a bulletin with a revised switch.
issues.next: Have the switch replaced. Always set the parking brake if you have to start it in Neutral.

issues.t: Idle control code from the throttle body
issues.sym: Check-engine light with code P0505, sometimes with an unsteady idle.
issues.why: Air leaks at the PCV hose or intake can trigger it. If none are found, the throttle body itself is the fix in the bulletin.
issues.next: Have the intake checked for leaks first, then the throttle body.

issues.t: Driver's power window switch can overheat
issues.sym: Window switch stops working, feels hot, or there is a burning plastic smell from the driver's door.
issues.why: Uneven grease on the switch contacts can make the master window switch malfunction and overheat. Toyota recalled these vehicles.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN. If you smell burning from the door, stop using the switch and get it repaired.

issues.t: Driver airbag spiral cable can break
issues.sym: Airbag warning light on, and sometimes the horn or steering wheel buttons stop working.
issues.why: A flat cable inside the spiral cable can be damaged as the steering wheel turns, which can turn off the driver airbag. Toyota recalled 2008-2010 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and have the spiral cable replaced.

issues.t: Seat belt pretensioner may fire unexpectedly
issues.sym: Usually no warning. A sensor fault may show the airbag light.
issues.why: If two sensors fail close together, the curtain airbag and belt pretensioner could activate without a crash. Toyota recalled 2008 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and have the repair done.

issues.t: Hybrid coolant hoses can rub on the steering shaft
issues.sym: Possible coolant leak or a low hybrid coolant level.
issues.why: Two hoses for the hybrid system's electric water pump could be routed where the steering intermediate shaft touches them. Toyota ran a service campaign.
issues.next: Ask a Toyota dealer whether campaign E0P was done on your VIN.

issues.t: Check-engine light with engine-off timer code
issues.sym: Check-engine light with code P2610 while the SUV runs normally.
issues.why: An internal timer fault in the engine computer sets the code. Toyota issued a bulletin with a fix.
issues.next: Have a dealer apply the bulletin fix so real faults are not hidden behind the light.

issues.t: Power liftgate stops or will not open
issues.sym: The power rear hatch will not open or stops partway, often in cold weather.
issues.why: Toyota issued a bulletin for the power back door system on these models.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the bulletin. Open the hatch manually in the meantime.

issues.t: Roof rail fasteners may be loose
issues.sym: Rattling from the roof rails, or a rail that shifts when loaded.
issues.why: Roof rail fasteners may not have been tightened properly at the factory. Toyota recalled 2017 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and do not carry cargo on the roof until fixed.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine
issues.sym: Rough running, warning lights, sputtering, hard starting, or the engine stalling while driving.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank can stop working. Toyota recalled 2018-2019 models and later expanded the recall to 2017.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and get the pump replaced. If it sputters, get off the road safely.

issues.t: Sudden loss of brake assist
issues.sym: The brake pedal suddenly turns hard and the SUV needs much more effort to stop. A brake warning may appear.
issues.why: The rotor in the brake booster vacuum pump may have been machined wrong, so the pump can fail. Toyota recalled 2018 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN. A hard brake pedal needs attention before more driving.

issues.t: 8-speed automatic whine and shift complaints
issues.sym: A high-pitched whine under acceleration, harsh or delayed shifts, or hesitation. Non-hybrid models only.
issues.why: Owners report noise and durability trouble with the Aisin 8-speed automatic, and a class action alleges a defect. There is no recall.
issues.next: Document the noise and have it checked while under warranty. Ask the dealer about software updates.

issues.t: Engine can stall after auto stop-start
issues.sym: The engine fails to restart or stalls after the stop-start system shuts it off at a light.
issues.why: A programming error in the engine computer may cut fuel delivery during stop-start. Toyota recalled 2020 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN for the software update. Turn stop-start off until it is done.

issues.t: Wrong seat covers can block the side airbag
issues.sym: No symptoms. The risk is reduced protection in a side crash.
issues.why: Some front seats received the wrong trim covers, which can keep the seat-mounted side airbag from deploying properly. Toyota recalled 2020 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and have the covers replaced.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status shows OFF with an adult seated, or the airbag warning light is on.
issues.why: A short circuit in the passenger seat occupant sensor can switch off the airbag. Toyota recalled 2020-2021 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and get the sensor replaced. Seat adults in back until then if the light shows OFF.

issues.t: Front lower bumper cover can come loose
issues.sym: Dragging or flapping noise from the front after hitting a curb, snowbank, or debris.
issues.why: The lower bumper cover may detach after a minor impact and become a road hazard. Toyota recalled 2020-2023 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN. Pull over and secure or remove a loose cover.

issues.t: Second-row seatbacks may not lock
issues.sym: A second-row seatback moves or folds forward when it should be locked upright.
issues.why: Recliner return springs may not latch the seatback fully. Toyota recalled 2021-2025 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and push on each seatback to confirm it is locked before riding.

issues.t: Driver airbag spiral cable can disconnect
issues.sym: Airbag warning light on, sometimes with steering wheel buttons not working.
issues.why: The spiral cable connection may separate and turn off the driver airbag. A second recall covers trucks where the first repair was incomplete.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN, including the follow-up campaign.

issues.t: Gauge cluster may skip startup warnings
issues.sym: Speed, brake, or tire pressure warnings do not appear on the instrument panel at startup.
issues.why: A fault in the instrument panel can keep key warnings from showing. Toyota recalled 2023-2025 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN for the fix.

issues.t: Backup camera can freeze or go blank
issues.sym: The rearview camera picture freezes or the screen stays blank in reverse.
issues.why: A software error affects the camera display. Toyota recalled 2023-2025 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN for the software update and use mirrors carefully until then.

issues.t: Third-row center belt anchor angle
issues.sym: No obvious symptom. The third-row center seat belt may not protect as intended.
issues.why: The roof anchor for the third-row center belt may be installed at the wrong angle. Toyota recalled 2024-2025 models.
issues.next: Check recall status by VIN and avoid using that seat until repaired.

issues.t: Brake fluid level sensor may be unplugged (recall)
issues.sym: The low brake fluid warning light never comes on, even when the reservoir is actually low.
issues.why: On some vehicles built in mid-2016 the connector on the brake fluid reservoir sensor was left unplugged at the factory, so a falling fluid level goes unreported.
issues.next: Have the dealer plug the sensor back in under the recall, and in the meantime look at the fluid level in the reservoir yourself.

issues.t: Replacement windshield can let water reach the engine computer (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights, rough running, stalling or a no-start after the windshield has been replaced, sometimes with damp carpet or headliner.
issues.why: Certain aftermarket replacement windshields do not seal to the right shape, so rain can run down inside and soak the wiring harness and the engine control module.
issues.next: Have the glass and the module inspected before the fault gets worse; the campaign covers replacing the windshield and checking the module.

issues.t: Power steering control unit can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes much heavier than normal, usually with a warning light on the dash.
issues.why: Some electric power steering control units were damaged while being built and can quit working without warning while you drive.
issues.next: Treat this as a safety item and have the dealer check the unit serial number under the recall; it is replaced at no charge.

issues.t: Front passenger seat sensing may never have been recalibrated (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you can see or feel, but the front passenger airbag may not judge correctly whether to fire or how hard.
issues.why: When accessories were fitted at the dealer, the seat occupant sensing system was supposed to be retested and recalibrated, and on some vehicles that step was skipped.
issues.next: Have the dealer run the occupant sensing test and recalibration under the recall.

issues.t: Load capacity label may not allow for fitted accessories (recall)
issues.sym: The weight limit printed on the door jamb sticker is higher than the vehicle can really carry.
issues.why: Accessories added before delivery added weight that was never subtracted from the printed passenger and cargo limit.
issues.next: Pick up the corrected label from the dealer and load the vehicle to the new numbers.

issues.t: Weight label can overstate what you may carry (recall)
issues.sym: The cargo and passenger weight figure on the door jamb label is too high for how the vehicle was actually built.
issues.why: Accessories installed at the port or the dealer were not counted when the label was printed.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for the free corrected label and go by the lower limit when loading.

issues.t: Door jamb tire and loading label can become illegible (recall)
issues.sym: The print on the tire pressure and loading sticker fades or smears until you cannot read it.
issues.why: The label material used on some vehicles does not hold up, which leaves the vehicle without the required information.
issues.next: Order the free replacement label from the dealer so the tire pressures and limits are on the car.

issues.t: Seat heater wiring can be crushed and short out (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell from a front seat, a heater that works only sometimes, a blown fuse, or scorch marks under the cushion.
issues.why: Sitting down squeezes the cushion against the seat heater wiring; over time the insulation wears through and the wires can short and overheat.
issues.next: Stop using the seat heater and have it inspected; under the campaign the heater is disconnected.
